name: Survey tile in Cancer
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.1 degrees north of the ecliptic in Cancer, imaged by SPHEREx 22 times in 7 visits over 46 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 44 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 46 hours starting 2025-10-20, at wavelengths from 0.80 to 4.39 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
